project.name: speech
project.description:
SpeechTextNormalizer - the one place raw LLM/agent text is turned into something a text-to-speech engine should actually SAY out loud (strip markdown/HTML/emoji/control characters, turn bare URLs into "a link", collapse whitespace into sentence pauses).
Its own module, and a true leaf (zero dependency on any other core module, JDK-only, pure static functions - same shape as "crypto" and "storage"), because the two text-to-speech clients that need it live in modules that do NOT depend on each other: elevenlabs (ElevenLabsClient#textToSpeech) and sarvam (SarvamTextToSpeechClient#synthesize). Their only shared ancestors before this module were crypto/security/tenancy/storage, none of which is a sane home for text processing, and duplicating the normalizer into both would guarantee the two speech surfaces drift apart. Nothing in this module depends on anything, so it slots into the reactor ahead of everything else exactly like crypto does.
